lines.zh: 我的骨节一路响着往前走。
lines.en: My joints rattle as I walk.

lines.zh: 我没有肌肉，只靠骨头撑着。
lines.en: I have no muscle; bones alone hold me.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，声音很清楚。
lines.en: Step by step, and it is very audible.
I move toward that open ground.
My skull tilts and rights itself.
Dry twigs crack under me.
I go around an old skeleton.
I rest my hand bones on my chest.
I head over toward the noise.
I go very slowly, but I do not stop.
I stand and my bones sway gently.
I turn my skull slowly.
The wind passes between my ribs.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一副摆设。
lines.en: I hold still like an ornament.
My jaw works open and shut.
I lift a hand, then let it hang.
I listen, very closely.
My bones shine white in the light.
I shift my weight to the other foot.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己为什么还站着。
lines.en: I do not know why I still stand.
I click my teeth slowly.
I wait for whoever called me.

lines.zh: 我的指骨在空里敲了敲。
lines.en: My finger bones tap at nothing.
I made no move at all.
My head leans to one side.
I stand in the wind a while longer.

lines.zh: 我把头骨转过来正对你。
lines.en: I turn my skull square to you.
You still have flesh on you.
I tilt my skull and eye you.
There are no eyes in my sockets.

lines.zh: 我抬起手骨，比了一下你的高度。
lines.en: I raise a hand bone to measure your height.
You stand your ground; that is rare.
My jaw works open once.

lines.zh: 我在想，你也会变成我这样吗。
lines.en: I wonder whether you will end up like me.
You step back and my head follows.
I come slowly nearer.
I said not a single word.
We size each other up.
A blow snaps one of my bones.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，骨节都在响。
lines.en: I give half a step, joints rattling.
I bend to pick up the bone shard.

lines.zh: 我的头骨歪了，我正回来。
lines.en: My skull is knocked askew and I right it.
Several parts of me have come loose.

lines.zh: 我一点一点把自己拼回。
lines.en: I piece myself back together bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我没有痛，可我知道受损。
lines.en: I feel no pain, but I know the damage.
I keep that in a joint.
This frame will not come apart yet.

lines.zh: 骨头响了一声，就算回答。
lines.en: One rattle of bone is my answer.

lines.zh: 苹果举得再高，我也没处装。
lines.en: Raise that apple all you like; I have nowhere to put it.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我不明白。
lines.en: You hold it up and I do not understand.

lines.zh: 这物件于我没半分用处。
lines.en: That thing is of not the slightest use.
I look, then look away.
I touch it and it is cold.
I have no need to feed.
I go around it.
You set it down and I do not pick it up.
These cannot draw me.
I go on along my old line.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，撞散了两根骨。
lines.en: You hit me and knock two bones loose.
I reach and set the bones back.
I sway once and then nail down.

lines.zh: 这身骨头很轻，可不好推。
lines.en: These bones are light but hard to shove.
Your shoulder passes between my ribs.
I turn aside and clear the way.
Bone on bone rings sharply.
I step back and rearrange myself.
This close, you can hear me rattle.
Do not hit me again; I will come apart.
I am only bone.
I have no such thought.
I move my gaze away.
I do not even have a heart.
My ribs are empty.
I need nobody.
I stand and not a bone moves.
It left and I still stand here.
I hear my own bones creak.
I go the other way.
I pinch it between finger bones.
I hold it before my socket.
My fingers cannot hold it well.

lines.zh: 它掉下去了，我看了半天。
lines.en: It fell and I stare at it.
I tuck it between my ribs.
This is not needed.
I fling it away.
I pick it up and put it down.
This is not interesting.
I go on forward.

lines.zh: 你动了，我的头骨就转过去。
lines.en: You move and my skull turns.
I raise my hand bones.
I turn my eye socket on you.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过去，骨头一路响。
lines.en: I walk at you, bones rattling.
Only you are still standing here.
My jaw unhinges toward you.
My bones draw taut.
One step puts me before you.
My pace quickens.
I bring my hand to your face.
Your way out is blocked.
I count your footfalls.
Light shows between my bones.
I lean your way.
You are already within my reach.
I click my teeth again.
I lower my skull slowly.

lines.zh: 你看起来也能变成骨头。
lines.en: You look like you could become bone.
I am not the least hurried.
I point at you with a finger bone.

lines.zh: 我跟着你转，骨头咯咯响。
lines.en: I turn with you, bones clacking.

lines.zh: 你转个方向，我跟个方向。
lines.en: You turn a way and I turn after.
I herd you into the corner.
I press in, one rattle per step.
My shadow sways on the wall.
You circle; I do not.

lines.zh: 我把手骨伸出去量距离。
lines.en: I stretch a hand bone to measure.
Half a step from you is half a step from me.
My bones draw tighter.
You are already panting.
I wait for you to meet the wall.
I know this area inside out.
My jaw stays open.
One more move and I lunge.
My frame crouches lower.
My finger bones click.
Your steps have gone all to pieces.
I have you in the corner.
I need no breath at all.
Time means little to me.

lines.zh: 我一爪抓下去，骨尖很利。
lines.en: My claws come down, bone tips sharp.
I strike its head with a hand bone.
My finger bones dig into its hide.
I ram it and every bone rattles.

lines.zh: 它砍我，砍断了一根肋骨。
lines.en: It cuts me and breaks a rib.
I put out a claw and rake again.
I pin it to the stone wall.
My jaw has clamped on.

lines.zh: 它退了，我的骨头散了半边。
lines.en: It retreats and half my frame is loose.
I slowly set my bones back.
That one landed heavy.
My bones are still together.
I shake off the bone dust.
I raise my hand bones again.

lines.zh: 我从地里聚成形，骨头先出现。
lines.en: I gather up out of the ground, bones first.

lines.zh: 我站直的时候，骨节一路响。
lines.en: As I straighten, my joints rattle all the way.

lines.zh: 我抬起头骨，四面看了看。
lines.en: I lift my skull and look around.
It is so quiet there is an echo.
My foot bones press the soil.

lines.zh: 我伸手摸了摸自己的肋骨。
lines.en: I reach and touch my own ribs.
I turn toward the light.
My shadow is long and thin.

lines.zh: 我又听见了召唤的余音。
lines.en: I still hear the echo of the call.
I let my hand bones hang at my side.
I walk toward the open ground.
I begin to turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我身上没有一块是暖的。
lines.en: Not one part of me is warm.
I close my jaw.
I test my steps one by one.
This place will do to stand on.
There is still soil between my bones.
I wait for someone to come.
I tip my skull aside.
When I make a sound, it is bones.

lines.zh: 火苗钻进肋缝，骨头发脆。
lines.en: Flame crawls into my ribs and my bones turn brittle.

lines.zh: 落地时我的骨架散了半边。
lines.en: On landing half my frame scatters.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的空腔，我沉下去。
lines.en: Water fills my hollows and I sink.

lines.zh: 炸风把我的骨头吹得四散。
lines.en: The blast scatters my bones.

lines.zh: 有东西打穿了我的肋骨。
lines.en: Something pierces my ribs.

lines.zh: 术式缠住我的骨节，它们都不动了。
lines.en: An art binds my joints and they stop moving.
My bones are growing brittle.

lines.zh: 雷穿过我的骨架，我停了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning runs my frame and I stall.

lines.zh: 脚下没有东西，我的骨头散落下去。
lines.en: Nothing below and my bones scatter down.
